findingDetails.title: The three staged-list scans in pre-commit disagree on which change types they see
findingDetails.scopeProof: read pre-commit:1-172 end to end; the three git -C "$TREE_ROOT" diff --cached invocations are the only staged-list reads in the file, and their flags differ at :45, :71 and :132
findingDetails.case: a commit deletes .skilled/skills/sk-prompt/SKILL.md; the card-sync scan at :62-71 filters the deletion out, so CARD_SURFACE_STAGED stays 0 and the prompt-knowledge drift guard never runs even though the card surface changed
findingDetails.claim: Two of the three staged-list scans exclude deletions while the third includes them, so the card-sync check cannot see a staged deletion of a prompt-skill file.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: checked whether a deletion could reach the card check another way: the only producer of CARD_SURFACE_STAGED is the loop at :62-71, and it reads the filtered list; checked whether the hygiene scan needs deletions: it does not, because a deleted file has no comments, so only the card scan is affected
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the filter may be deliberate for the card check on the theory that a deletion cannot introduce drift; that reading does not explain why the vendored scan at :132 deliberately omits the filter, which shows the author knew the difference mattered
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: drop if a maintainer records that a deletion cannot cause prompt-knowledge drift and adds a test asserting the card check stays silent on a deletion

results.notes: completion criterion 4 re-executed read-only: status --json reports PASSED with an empty offLayout

noveltyJustification: one new P2 (weight 1) against eight carried P2 findings (weight 8) gives a weighted new share of 0.111; the finding is a behavioural inconsistency between the three scans that only a whole-file read of the hook exposes
